cases.sentence: Горе тем, кто идет в ___ за помощью.
cases.translation: Woe to those who go to Egypt for help.
cases.explain: The preposition в with a destination takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда ___ рычит, огромный лев над своей добычей.
cases.explain: Лев as the subject of the verb рычит uses the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Каждый из вас отвергнет идолов из серебра и золота, которых сделали ваши грешные ___.
cases.explain: Руки in the plural as the subject requires nominative case.

cases.sentence: Ассирийцы падут от ___ , но не человеческого.
cases.translation: The Assyrians will fall by the sword.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from/by) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Возвещает Господь, чей огонь на ___ , чей очаг в Иерусалиме.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on/in) with a static location requires the prepositional case.

cases.translation: The Lord of Hosts will protect Jerusalem.
cases.explain: The transitive verb прикроет (will protect) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Помогающий споткнется, принимающий ___ рухнет, и оба погибнут.
cases.translation: The one receiving help will fall.
cases.explain: Помощь as the direct object of the participial construction takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Господь сил сойдет, чтобы сражаться на горе ___ и на ее высотах.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with a mountain or location uses the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Горе тем, кто идет в Египет за помощью, кто полагается на коней, кто верит во множество колесниц.
reading.question: What does God condemn in this passage?
options: Trusting in Egypt, horses, and chariots instead of God
reading.correct: Trusting in Egypt, horses, and chariots instead of God
reading.explain: Woe is pronounced on those who seek help from Egypt and trust in horses and chariots.

reading.ru: Но и он мудр, он наведет бедствие, и слов своих назад не возьмет.
reading.question: What does God say about Himself?
options: He is wise and will bring disaster, His words will not be taken back
reading.correct: He is wise and will bring disaster, His words will not be taken back
reading.explain: God affirms His wisdom and that He will bring about His threatening words without recalling them.

reading.ru: Египтяне — люди, а не Бог. Кони их — плоть, а не дух. Когда Господь протянет руку, помогающий споткнется, принимающий помощь рухнет.
reading.question: What is the contrast being made here?
options: Egyptians and horses are mortal, but God is divine and eternal
reading.correct: Egyptians and horses are mortal, but God is divine and eternal
reading.explain: The passage contrasts mortal humans and animals with the divine God, showing their inability to help.

reading.ru: Когда лев рычит, огромный лев над своей добычей, пусть даже созовут на него множество пастухов, он их криков не испугается.
reading.question: What is compared to a roaring lion?
options: The Lord defending His people against attackers
A wild animal in the forest
reading.correct: The Lord defending His people against attackers
reading.explain: God is compared to a mighty lion over its prey, unafraid even if many shepherds are called against it.

reading.ru: Ведь в тот день каждый из вас отвергнет идолов из серебра и золота, которых сделали ваши грешные руки.
reading.question: What will the people reject?
options: Idols of silver and gold made by their own hands
reading.correct: Idols of silver and gold made by their own hands
reading.explain: In that day, each person will cast away their idols of silver and gold that they made.

reading.ru: Ассирийцы падут от меча, но не человеческого. Меч пожрет их, но не меч смертных.
reading.question: What kind of sword will defeat the Assyrians?
options: A sword not made by humans, but by God
reading.correct: A sword not made by humans, but by God
reading.explain: The Assyrians will fall by a sword not made by mortals—the sword of God.
